name: Microgrid generator minimum-load restraint
summary: Coordinates dispatch with the documented minimum operating-load constraints of assigned generators.
description: Coordinates dispatch with the documented minimum operating-load constraints of assigned generators. Active-power dispatch allocates the electrical work performed by the microgrid resources. A total site target, a resource power limit and the actual measured contribution are different quantities that must be connected clearly in the diagram.

In a microgrid with solar generation, a battery and generators, the controller can allocate an import/export target among the available resources while reserving the power needed for operating disturbances. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Generator load and permitted range” at the input and “Minimum-load dispatch restraint” at the output. Limits come from the selected generator application.
